|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Wookiee Warrior]] (version 1 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (3 September 2021). The current text is [[Wookiee Warrior (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-o">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1a519d514de0c15525458580c14f6b792a14c46a swccg-card-json commit 1a519d514d] (4 September 2021): dating evidence only.</ref>: “During battle at a site, may add one destiny to total power. Once during battle, unless 'hit,' may lose this character to restore your 'hit' character here to normal.” No E mark. Power 2. Margin: “Wookiee”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wookiee Warrior (Errata)]]): PC re-rendering of the Virtual Set 16 images; card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “During battle at a site, may add one destiny to total power. Once during battle, unless 'hit,' may lose this character to restore your 'hit' character here to normal.” Same game text words as the original; no E mark. The PC published a second, pixel-identical copy of this image on 5 July 2022 (format conversion only, no visible change).<ref name="img-rr7">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref> '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image: the side copyright line changed from “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” to “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, the artist credit line was reset (e.g. “ArtStation.com” → “ArtStation” on Grogu), and the game text was re-typeset (new line breaks). A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Wookiee Warrior (Errata 2)]]): PC errata of 30 December 2024; card image marked E1 published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4da5a9ec5636a391e4113eba01c7463a1b42ba32 swccg-card-json commit 4da5a9ec56] (13 January 2025): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Power +1 at a Kashyyyk site. While present at a Kashyyyk site, opponent may not cancel or modify your Force drains here. Unless 'hit,' may forfeit in place of your other 'hit' character at same site, restoring that character to normal.” Power 4. The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024): “Power increased from 2 to 4.” The card prints “E1”; it is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. '''What changed:''' The whole game text was replaced: the add-a-destiny and lose-to-restore abilities became “Power +1 at a Kashyyyk site. While present at a Kashyyyk site, opponent may not cancel or modify your Force drains here. Unless 'hit,' may forfeit in place of your other 'hit' character at same site, restoring that character to normal.” Power changed from 2 to 4. The card gained the E1 mark (printed).
